defs.meaning: （有计划的）活动，运动；战役，战斗（campaign 的复数）
领导（参加）运动，从事竞选活动（campaign 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: Voters are disillusioned with the mudslinging campaigns run by many candidates in recent years.
examples.zh: 选民们对近几年很多候选人在竞选活动中互相诋毁深感失望。

examples.en: They're able to carry out individually targeted campaigns to cheat people.
examples.zh: 他们能够进行有针对性的活动来欺骗人们。

examples.en: Armed with this knowledge, they're able to carry out individually targeted campaigns to cheat people.
examples.zh: 他们用这些知识武装自己，能够进行单独的、有针对性的活动来欺骗人们。
